title: US Notifiable Disease Surveillance Tracker Input

diseaseKeyword.title: Disease keyword
diseaseKeyword.description: Free-text, case-insensitive match against CDC's official disease label, e.g. "measles", "salmonella", "pertussis". A broad keyword can match several related labels (e.g. "measles" matches both "Measles, Indigenous" and "Measles, Imported").

area.title: Reporting area
area.description: A US state name, HHS region name, or "U.S. Residents" for the national total. Must match CDC's reporting-area name exactly (e.g. "California", "New England", "U.S. Residents").

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of weekly records to return, most recent week first.
